changes.text: 现在回到戈登。八人投降时，他正是阳澄湖降约的保人。梁启超写他「聞鴻章之食言也，大怒」：听说李鸿章不守诺言，戈登勃然大怒，想杀李鸿章抵罪，「自攜短銃以覓之」，亲自带着短枪去找李鸿章。「鴻章避之，不敢歸營」，李鸿章躲开了，不敢回营。几天后，戈登的怒气渐渐消了，这才作罢。梁启超对此评论说，李鸿章在这件事上「有慚德」，也就是有愧于心。他列出三重罪过：杀降违背公理，背约食言，欺骗了身为朋友的戈登。在梁启超看来，戈登恨到想动刀泄愤，是理所当然的。他也承认，李鸿章或许鉴于苗沛霖、李世忠的旧事，有不得已之处，但认为这件事正可见李鸿章一生好用小聪明、小手段。

Now return to Gordon. When the eight surrendered, he had been the guarantor of the pact made on Yangcheng Lake. Liang writes, in effect, that when Gordon heard Li Hongzhang had broken his word, he was enraged. Gordon wanted to kill Li Hongzhang to make him pay, and went looking for him with a pistol himself. Li Hongzhang kept out of his way and dared not return to camp. After a few days Gordon's anger slowly cooled, and he let the matter drop. Liang then comments that Li Hongzhang had cause for shame here. He lists three offences: killing men who had surrendered violated what is right; Li Hongzhang broke the agreement and went back on his word; and he deceived Gordon, wronging a friend. In Liang's view, Gordon's fury, to the point of wanting to stab him, was only to be expected. Liang allows that Li Hongzhang may have had the earlier cases of Miao Peilin and Li Shizhong in mind and acted partly out of necessity, but he holds that the episode shows Li Hongzhang's lifelong fondness for petty cleverness and small tricks.

把这件事拆开看，降约里有三个角色。许诺的是程学启：湖上与降将订约的是他和戈登，许以总兵、副将等职的是他；作保的是戈登，书中明说降将「不疑」是因为他；决定不兑现的，是程学启与李鸿章的密谋。值得注意的是，主意出自程学启的判断，戈登去找的却是李鸿章，书里用的词也是「鴻章之食言」；梁启超在评论里也把背约食言、欺骗戈登算作李鸿章的罪过。一种解释是：在戈登看来，前线将领的许诺代表的是统帅；统帅点头杀降，就等于统帅本人食言。许诺可以由前线作出，兑现与否却要由上面来担。

Take the episode apart and the pact had three roles. Cheng Xueqi made the promise: he and Gordon settled terms with the defectors on the lake, and it was Cheng who promised them posts such as brigade general and deputy general. Gordon guaranteed it, and the book says plainly that the defectors had no doubts because of him. The decision not to pay came from the secret plan between Cheng and Li Hongzhang. Yet the idea grew out of Cheng's judgment, while the man Gordon went hunting for was Li Hongzhang, and the book's own phrase is that Hongzhang had broken his word; in his commentary, Liang also counts breaking the agreement and deceiving Gordon among Li Hongzhang's offences. One reading is that, to Gordon, a field commander's promise spoke for his superior; once the superior agreed to kill men who had surrendered, the broken word was his. Promises may be made at the front, but whether they are kept is answered higher up.
代价也分两笔。眼前那笔很清楚：苏州到手，李鸿章加衔。长远那笔，本文依据的记载写到：李鸿章躲了几天，戈登怒气消退，常胜军之后仍与淮军并肩作战；梁启超则在评论中认定此举有愧。后来的合作也不能证明这一步做对了，只能说明这道裂痕没有让双方当场决裂。如果承诺的风险真的太大，本文提出两种可能的做法：许诺之前先请统帅定好权限，反悔之前先和保人商量。这两种做法都是本文的假设。

The costs fall into two accounts. The immediate one is plain: Suzhou was taken and Li Hongzhang received a new title. Of the longer account, the material this article draws on records that Li Hongzhang stayed out of sight for a few days, Gordon's anger subsided, and the Ever-Victorious Army went on fighting beside the Huai Army; Liang, for his part, judges in his commentary that the act was cause for shame. Their later cooperation does not prove the decision was right; it shows only that the rift did not break them apart on the spot. If honouring the promise really carried too great a risk, this article suggests two other courses: before promising, agree with the commander-in-chief on the limits of what may be offered; before going back on the promise, consult the guarantor. Both are this article's own hypotheses.

dispositions.rationale: 在戈登息怒之后补上梁启超的评论，中英同步：李鸿章此事「有慚德」，杀降、背约食言、欺骗朋友戈登三重罪过；梁启超认为戈登的愤恨理所当然；他也承认李鸿章或许鉴于苗沛霖、李世忠旧事有不得已之处，但认为此事可见李鸿章一生好用小智小术。全段写明这是梁启超的评价，并在 ev 中加入 E20。

evidence.quote: 殺降背公理一也，負約食言二也，欺戈登負友人三也
雖彼鑒於苗沛霖、李世忠故事，其個或有所大不得已者存，而文忠生平好用小智小術，亦可以見其概矣

dispositions.rationale: 在「鴻章之食言」之后补一句，照实转述梁启超在评论中把背约食言、欺骗戈登算作李鸿章的罪过；其后的“一种解释是”仍保留，只用于本文对戈登视角的推断。英文同步，ev 中加入 E20。

evidence.quote: 負約食言二也，欺戈登負友人三也

dispositions.rationale: 删去“只涉及几件事”这一不准确的来源范围断言，改为“本文依据的记载写到”，列出原有三件事，并补上梁启超在评论中认定此举有愧。英文同步，ev 中加入 E20。
